title: Illustration use / Title page with waterfront fragments

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Reserve clear space for the main message so illustration enriches a title without competing with it.
strategic_value: A bold title beside familiar waterfront motifs can make a Helsinki presentation feel both clear and distinctive.
demonstration: Large black placeholder text fills the upper left on pale blue; smaller date text and logo sit below, while separate building, plant and walking motifs occupy the right.
practical_value: Concentrate illustration on one side when a title requires a large uninterrupted reading area.

content_islands.name: Title hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Stack the large heading, small subtitle/date and tiny framed logo at left.

content_islands.name: Loose illustration field
content_islands.spec: Distribute waterfront, plant and walking fragments down the right with some cropped at the edges.

ingredient.name: Title-page illustration placement
ingredient.role: Support the title without crowding it.
ingredient.application: Group motifs on one side and leave the title area open.
ingredient.scope: Observed placeholder layout, not a mandatory template; the printed date does not establish the edition of the whole deck.

reference_purposes.Application: The slide applies isolated illustration elements to a title-page layout.
reference_purposes.Expression: The pale-blue field and scattered fragments establish an informal illustrated character.
